title: Separate SBI Multi-Rail Distribution, Actual Capital, Chain Scope and Scheduled XRP Escrow Events

decisions.decision: Treat SBI as a multi-rail strategy: XRP rewards/exchange, USDC/RLUSD, JPYSC, Arc, Open Standard/OUSD, Solana, tokenized MMF and trust/custody.
decisions.rationale: Official announcements document multiple distinct rails; no exclusive XRP strategy is established.

decisions.decision: Classify card points, shareholder coupons and START bond XRP rewards as distribution/incentives, not spot demand.
decisions.rationale: No aggregate conversion volumes or inventory-versus-market sourcing disclosed.
Official service terms explicitly exclude XRPL for VCTRADE RLUSD deposits/withdrawals.

decisions.decision: Correct Bitbank acquisition status to conditional agreement, completion unverified.
decisions.rationale: Official June25 release conditions closing on regulatory clearance and other terms; no official completion notice found. Prior 'completed Oct1' ledger wording is superseded, not deleted.

decisions.decision: Treat Arc as a separate USDC-native network, not an XRP network.
decisions.rationale: Circle names SBI validator, Coinbase exchange access, Morpho credit; Arc fees are USDC.

decisions.decision: Treat Nov1 1B escrow event as scheduled release, not sale or net-supply forecast.
decisions.rationale: Actual EscrowFinish, re-escrow, destination and exchange disposition are unknown.

decisions.decision: Do not infer XRP replenishment from Binance aggregate $1.34B token acquisition plan.
decisions.rationale: No XRP-specific allocation disclosed; initial PoR target elapsed and no completed snapshot surfaced in current search.

decisions.decision: Keep TradRadar, CryptoKeyhole and Alpha Finance market observations as separate provider-scoped series; admit none as predictive feature.
decisions.rationale: ETF coverage/cutoff differs; OI contract universe not reconciled.

decisions.decision: Use PR #1410's latest-at-or-before target sampling/effective-horizon contract as preferred design for sparse feeds; retain PR #1400 strict-equality branch as conservative alternative.
decisions.rationale: Both exact-head CI/gates passed, but #1410 records effective horizon/lag rather than forcing exact timestamp equality.

decisions.decision: Keep PR #1411 as a draft security proposal; main token-input workflow remains active until approved merge.
decisions.rationale: The unsafe input and shell interpolation are removed only on the PR branch; no secret or deployment operation was performed.

decisions.decision: Correct archive pointer chunk metadata and immutable snapshot reference fields after the exact-head validator failed closed.
decisions.rationale: The validator requires git_blob_sha on archive chunks and a snapshot_reference pointer with matching record_type, snapshot_id, captured_at_utc and index_format_version. The initial append used noncanonical metadata; no archive data was lost.

decisions.decision: Use node IDs rather than display labels in relationship graph edge endpoints and ensure every endpoint resolves.
decisions.rationale: Graph schema integrity requires stable node references; the two card product nodes were added and the planned SBI Clearing Trust merger edge was corrected.

alternatives_considered: Treat all SBI rewards as net XRP spot buying — rejected for lack of sourcing/volume evidence.
Treat RLUSD on VCTRADE as XRPL support — rejected by Ethereum-only service terms.
Treat Bitbank as already consolidated — rejected by conditional official transaction terms.
Treat gross escrow unlock as immediate sell supply — rejected; escrow finish/re-escrow/sale are distinct.
Merge stale PRs or rebase branches automatically — rejected by preservation and approval constraints.
consequences: Market features remain unadmitted; no directional forecast.
XRP escrow event is added to the event calendar with post-event outcome capture.
SBI's XRP retail distribution is monitored as a possible demand channel but not scored as spot purchases until market-source evidence exists.
Bitbank ownership state remains conditional until official closing confirmation.
Main workflow write risks remain open; #1411 is a proposal only.
next_actions: Capture XRPL EscrowFinish transactions at/after Nov1 00:00 UTC and track re-escrow/destination for 24h and 7d.
Recheck Binance official PoR publication and crosswalk XRP reserve addresses against customer liabilities.
Request/ingest SBI public reward and custody disclosures; do not infer reward sourcing.
Verify Bitbank completion from an official closing announcement and any JFTC clearance.
Measure Arc USDC supply, Morpho markets, Coinbase access and SBI validator activity separately from XRPL.
Build point-in-time fixed-horizon feature store and walk-forward baselines; no live forecast before leakage/calibration gates.

initial_validator_failure.root_cause: The three new archive pointer chunks used blob_sha instead of the validator-required git_blob_sha; the latest_snapshot pointer omitted record_type, snapshot_id, captured_at_utc and index_format_version. The validator therefore could not load the new shards and correctly rejected the snapshot references. The archive files themselves were readable and their blob SHA readbacks matched.
corrective_actions: Changed new archive chunk metadata to git_blob_sha and removed noncanonical chunk_count fields.
Added snapshot_reference record_type, snapshot_id, captured_at_utc and index_format_version to the ledger pointer.
Corrected graph edge endpoints to node IDs; added missing card-product nodes and corrected the planned trust merger edge.
